record.question: DNA finger printing is based on unique:
record.explanation: Answer B: Tandem repeats. Forensic DNA profiling commonly compares variable tandem-repeat loci, especially short tandem repeats; their allele combinations are highly discriminating between individuals (except identical twins). Reference: https://www.fbi.gov/how-we-can-help-you/dna-fingerprint-act-of-2005-expungement-policy/codis-and-ndis-fact-sheet. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
